capabilities: translate selected text with streaming typewriter output
look up short words with phonetics, multi-domain definitions and examples
generate parallel AI explanations in an independent language
read translations aloud with Volcano Engine neural voices, including cloned voices
cache translations, explanations and TTS audio locally across sessions
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in translation, so users must leave the app to look up words or translate selected text.

relations.evidence: Volcano Engine big model, 16 voices (10 zh + 3 en + 3 multi); voice cloning (S_xxx ID)

requires.name: Translation API key (DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Kimi, Zhipu, or OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
Volcano Engine TTS AppID and Access Token

summary: Select-to-translate plugin that looks up short words in a dictionary, streams long-text translations with AI explanations, and reads results via Volcano TTS.
